public_postprocessing: A positive logit temperature and additive class intercepts are fit on the disjoint labeled public validation split. Legacy JSON field names retain the shorter public_class_bias_recalibrated label.
selection_caveat: The step grid follows an exploratory audit of existing results. Every step count is retained and must not be presented as a confirmatory test-selected configuration.
sensitivity_caveat: The one-step certificate is exact without a non-expansiveness assumption. Multi-step rows retain the clipped-update non-expansiveness caveat from the long PCA panel.
